# DSAIT4335 Recommender Systems — group project

Our group's fork of the lecturer's course version of RecBole
([masoudmansoury/RecBole_DSAIT4335](https://github.com/masoudmansoury/RecBole_DSAIT4335)).

- **Start here:** [`PROJECT.md`](../PROJECT.md) — setup, running experiments, results/figures/tables, report and Overleaf.
- **Workflow:** [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md) — branches, pull requests, syncing with the lecturer.
- **Our code:** [`project/`](../project) · **Report:** [`report/`](../report) · **Generated figures:** [`figures/generated/`](../figures/generated)
- The lecturer's original RecBole README is [`README.md`](../README.md) (unchanged).

> Pull requests go to **this fork's `main`**, not to the lecturer's repository.
